results.goal: the SHIPPED default cadence is in effect (3), extraction is on, a profile is set, and nothing has read yet — so the read J12.3 observes cannot be a leftover from an earlier check or an earlier run

the story is selected and its requirements are GREEN — the guard v2.3 plan 04 added, because a journey that never established its lorebooks gets silent no-op latches instead of a failure, and the symptom then surfaces 300 s later as a checkpoint that never arrives

three real turns at the shipped cadence produce an extraction read with NO help (any reason but manual/trigger/runNow), it accepts deltas, and every such read's window holds the player's own lines. Rewritten 2026-09-23 (L2) from the audit tail: the check demanded the reason `cadence`, but a scene or cue read that fires first is just as unaided and resets the cadence counter, so in 3 of 3 real runs the schedule fired as `scene:cast` / `cue:*` and the read labelled `cadence` never came due. Whether a read reached the latest player message is reported, not asserted, for the same reason.

an accepted delta's EVIDENCE is a verbatim quote (at least 12 characters, quotes and whitespace normalized) of one of the player's own lines inside the read's window. Rewritten 2026-09-23 (L2): the token-overlap form excluded `cross`/`guild`/`counter` as generic, and a real run whose evidence was exactly the player's line "I cross the guild hall to the quest counter" failed on it. A verbatim quote is the stronger claim, and the one the extraction contract states.

the checkpoint the read opened applied its effects — an owned ledger row per effect, `applied` — and the boundary log names the transition that fired. This is the leg the MODEL decides, so it is its own check: a model that will not commit costs this check, not the journey's point (J12.3/J12.4)
